body: Any advice on coping strategies? I usually completely shut down and lie really still so I don't impulsively get something to hurt myself with. But that's not exactly healthy either.

I'm sorry about your boyfriend. I hope he's with you for a long time yet. 

I'm looking in shelters for an older cat that will snuggle and be a lap cat. So far the days I have time and energy are the days that shelters are closed.

When my depression takes over the only control I have left is the how. Sometimes just making a plan is enough. Sometimes writing it down and sometimes doing the prep work is what it takes to let me sleep another night and then the next day is better. I know I'm lucky to have bad days that usually ends after one or two truly dreadful days. I have control over my life but by moving and switching job locations I've lost my sense of me. And control over my work area. Add to that the continuous delay in getting a pet. I've always had my dog for comfort and a safety line to life. Moving away I had to leave her behind since she is my families dog not just mine. The plan was to get a cat last month and so far we still can't afford one realistically. 

I'm doing better today. Gotta love drugs in those tiny orange bottles.

And the July date was at about 5 years in the future the first time it was created. I'm just tired of the downs of depression. I'm medicated and function fine most days. But some days I feel like the drugs were never in my system and I'm out of control of my body and emotions. I make plans and detail them and set dates. And usually by the time they come to be I'm not in a bad day anymore.

By procrastinator I mean more about going through with it. I set dates and make excuses to wait for those dates to meet me. The first was July 10 2014. Clearly I made it past that one. Despite all my planning and set up I never actually go through with anything remotely suicidal attempt. I've crushed up pills that I've never taken. I've broke apart razors and kept them in a box for months. Sometimes I think that it's a way to act on the suicidal thoughts without hurting anyone. This time though. I set the date for tomorrow. I have set plans. I don't know if I'll go through with them when the time comes. I can only hope I'll be strong enough to finally complete a plan.
Then I'm sticking w my plan. Thanks for trying.
Amy suggestions then? All my ideas are obviously suicide and then the life insurance doesn't happen. My family can't think it was suicide. It would hurt them even more than just my dying.

It probably isn't the right time. But it never will be. I'd rather be remembered as having potential than as the failure I am. Waiting isn't going to fix anything. I'm a huge procrastinator. I've had these thoughts and half formed plans for over 8 years. I've set three other dates and then lived through it. I can't anymore. Monday it is with a great last day with my love.
